articles.title: Polymarket aims for prediction market approval in Japan by 2030
articles.snippet: Mike Eidlin, head of Japan at cryptocurrency exchange Jupiter, is leading Polymarket's efforts, according to reports.

articles.title: Polymarket Taps Jupiter Exec to Lead Japan Push: Report
articles.snippet: The prediction market has reportedly appointed a representative in Japan as it aims to secure authorization to operate there by 2030.
